subject: Animation
title: The Lion King's Billion-Dollar Surprise
description: Learn The Lion King's Billion-Dollar Surprise in one minute.

hook.text: Disney considered The Lion King the B-team project. The best animators chose Pocahontas instead.

buildup.text: The Lion King tackled heavy themes for a children's film: death, responsibility, and betrayal.

discovery.text: Elton John and Tim Rice wrote songs that became cultural anthems far beyond the film itself.

twist.text: The Lion King earned nearly a billion dollars. The supposed B-project became Disney's biggest hit.

climax.text: It spawned a Broadway musical that became the highest-grossing show in theater history.

punchline.text: The project nobody wanted became Disney's crown jewel.

quiz.question: Why did Disney executives underestimate The Lion King?
options: They thought animated musicals were outdated
They considered it a lesser project and assigned top animators to Pocahontas instead
They thought audiences would not watch animal characters
